original_question: Let phi be an arbitrary plurisubharmonic function on a domain Omega contained in C^n. When (phi_j) is any sequence of bounded plurisubharmonic functions that decreases to phi, determine what can be said about the set of cluster points of the Monge-Ampere measures (dd^c phi_j)^n.
correct_elements: The draft already captures the paper's target almost verbatim: it is in the local setting of a domain Omega subset C^n, starts with an arbitrary plurisubharmonic function phi, uses a decreasing sequence of bounded plurisubharmonic approximants phi_j, and asks about the cluster points of the Monge-Ampere measures (dd^c phi_j)^n. It also correctly avoids drifting into the compact Kahler setting.
missing_details: The paper states this as an open question, not as a theorem or conjecture with a proposed answer.
The intended notion of cluster point is weak convergence in the sense of Radon measures; this is the surrounding measure-topology context supplied by Definition 1.1.
For bounded plurisubharmonic phi_j, (dd^c phi_j)^n is understood in the Bedford-Taylor sense; the draft leaves this implicit.
The immediate contextual point is that if phi belongs to the local domain of definition DMA(Omega), then this cluster set is reduced to a single Radon measure.
The surrounding discussion makes clear that the real obstruction is in higher dimension n >= 2, since for n = 1 the operator reduces to the Laplacian.
The paper does not impose boundedness or hyperconvexity on Omega for Question 1; it is any domain in C^n.
refined_question: Let Omega subset C^n be a domain, and let phi be an arbitrary plurisubharmonic function on Omega. For a pointwise decreasing sequence (phi_j) of bounded plurisubharmonic functions on Omega with phi_j decreasing to phi, consider the Bedford-Taylor Monge-Ampere measures (dd^c phi_j)^n. What can be said about the set of their weak cluster points as Radon measures on Omega?
justification: The draft is a near-paraphrase of Question 1 (Bedford) in the subsection on local domains of definition. Definition 1.1 immediately before it provides the exact local framework: weak convergence of Monge-Ampere measures to a Radon measure under decreasing approximation. The sentence immediately after Question 1 gives the key hidden context, namely that the cluster set collapses to a single Radon measure when phi lies in DMA(Omega). No explicit equivalent reformulation of Question 1 is given in the paper.

citations.label: sentence stating Bedford-Taylor well-definedness for all locally bounded psh functions
sentence after Question 1 identifying the singleton case when phi is in DMA(Omega)
opening discussion of n = 1 versus higher dimensions, and subsequent n = 2 / higher-dimensional context
